repository.name: vllm
repository.type: Python LLM inference and serving engine (CUDA/ROCm/CPU/XPU/TPU) with OpenAI-compatible REST API, gRPC server, and CLI
repository.summary: vLLM is a high-throughput LLM inference and serving library originally built around PagedAttention and continuous batching. The codebase is a large monolithic Python package with C++/CUDA extensions; architecturally it layers user-facing entrypoints (LLM class, OpenAI/Anthropic/MCP/gRPC servers) on top of an engine (the new `v1` engine plus a legacy `engine` shim), which orchestrates an executor that drives per-device workers running model code from `model_executor` against pluggable attention/KV-cache/quantization/LoRA/multimodal/spec-decode subsystems. Cross-cutting concerns — configuration, distributed communication, hardware platforms, torch.compile/CUDA-graph compilation, tokenizers, parsers, and utilities — sit alongside the request path as peer top-level modules.
